lastCompletedStory.title: Graph gate: Kahn cycle detection + referential-integrity reuse

nextStoryContext: src/issues/gate.ts exports runGraphGate(backlog: IssueEntry[]): GateResult. GateResult = { ok: true; warnings: string[] } | { ok: false; kind: 'cycle'|'integrity'; errors: string[]; warnings: string[] }. Three phases: (1) checkReferentialIntegrity hard-fail on missing-id/self-ref, (2) cross-stage blocker warnings, (3) Kahn residualIds from rankIssues for cycle detection + path reconstruction. US-004 (cam triage CLI) must call runGraphGate BEFORE writing any rank; if ok===false, abort without writing. The gate is a pure check -- no I/O, no writes. 22 tests in test/issues/gate.test.ts cover all three phases.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure algorithm story: no external npm library was introduced or changed. gate.ts imports only from internal modules (./types.ts, ./graph.ts, ./rank.ts).
